title: CXCA.S1.DT Determine cervical cancer screening eligibility (CQL)
description: The S1 decision table with its logic evaluated as REAL CQL: the dynamicValue expressions use text/cql whose text names a define in CXCAEligibilityLogic (near-verbatim from the WHO DAK), evaluated by the cqframework v5 KMP engine through the workflow library's ExpressionEvaluator seam. Compare with CXCAS1DT, the FHIRPath re-authoring of the same table.
